text: The Russian state is Rosneft's main shareholder, holding 40.4% of Rosneft through JSC Rosneftegaz, a company in 100% federal ownership.
short: The Russian state holds 40.4% of Rosneft through the 100% federally owned Rosneftegaz.

source.name: RIA Novosti: Совет директоров «Роснефти» продлил полномочия Сечина на пять лет
source.quote: Основной акционер "Роснефти" - государство, через компанию " Роснефтегаз " ему принадлежит 40,4% акций
source.note: EN: 'Rosneft's main shareholder is the state; through Rosneftegaz it owns 40.4% of the shares.' On the page the name Роснефтегаз is a hyperlink; the quote keeps the spacing of the stripped page text.

additionalSources.name: Rosneft: Shareholder structure
additionalSources.quote: JSC ROSNEFTEGAZ is in 100% federal ownership. The Russian Government’s direct share (through the Federal Agency for State Property Management) in Rosneft’s equity is 0.000000009%.
additionalSources.note: Table on the same page: JSC ROSNEFTEGAZ 4,281,663,840 shares, 40.40% equity stake. Register data as of 1 July 2021; RIA Novosti repeated the 40.4% state stake in December 2024.
